question:
With reference to the Vikram-1 launch vehicle, recently in news, consider the following statements:
1. It is India's first privately developed orbital-class rocket to place a payload in orbit.
2. It uses liquid fuel in all its stages.
3. It was launched from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1 is India's first private orbital-class rocket, launched from Sriharikota on 18 July 2026. It uses three solid-fuel stages plus a liquid-fuelled orbital adjustment module, so statement 2 is wrong.
subject: Science & Technology

question: The 'White Rabbit Technology', recently inaugurated for a demonstration network in Bengaluru, is best described as:
options: (a) A quantum-encryption protocol for securing UPI transactions
(b) An Ethernet-based protocol for sub-nanosecond synchronisation and dissemination of Indian Standard Time
(c) A satellite constellation for GPS-independent navigation
(d) An AI platform for real-time monitoring of food supply chains
explanation: White Rabbit, developed at CERN, enables ultra-precise Ethernet-based time synchronisation. Under 'One Nation, One Time', the Legal Metrology Division (Ministry of Consumer Affairs) with CSIR-NPL, ISRO, BSNL and SEBI is using it to distribute IST without relying on foreign GPS time sources.
subject: Science & Technology
micro_topic: White Rabbit / One Nation One Time (IST dissemination)

question: Which of the following has been added as the ninth core industry in the revised Index of Core Industries (base year 2022-23) announced by the Office of Economic Adviser, DPIIT?
explanation: The revised ICI series (base 2022-23, replacing 2011-12) adds iron ore as the ninth core industry alongside coal, crude oil, natural gas, refinery products, fertilizers, steel, cement and electricity; weights are derived pro-rata from the IIP (2022-23) series.
subject: Economy
